title: Charge limit
line: Stops charging at a limit you choose.
risk_note: A day-to-day setting with checked values; the original is always saved and put back.

changes.detail: The charge limit; the original is saved first.
Only on handhelds whose firmware forgets the limit: puts it back at start.

undo: Writes the original limit back (100 = no limit) and deletes the rule.

probe.what: A setting, not a workaround: status says whether this handheld has the control at all (applies=yes).
